tenderSchedule.title: e-Pos Rental
tenderSchedule.description: Selection of System Integrator for FPS Automation by Implementing Aadhaar Enabled Public Distribution System (SMART-PDS) involving Integration of e-POS Machines, Electronic Weighing Scales and IRIS scanners in Karnataka State on Rental Basis
tenderSchedule.deptName: Food Civil Supplies and Consumer Affairs Department

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall have experience as a System Integrator for FPS Automation by Implementing Aadhaar Enabled Public Distribution System involving Integration of e-POS Machines and IRIS scanners and Electronic Weighing Scales in any One State involving not less than 16,450 ePoS machines, IRIS scanners and Electronic Weighing Scales in any three years out of last five preceding financial years i.e. 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- The Bidder shall submit Go-Live certificate if the project is ongoing.  The Bidder shall submit completion certificate if the project is completed.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should provide a detailed Technical presentation about Understanding the Scope of the Project, Technical Approach, Methodology, Implementation and Work Plan, Organization and staffing pattern, Capacity building, Project planning & implementation, Detailed specifications of the devices, Compliance with required certification, and other requirements as specified in the tender document . In addition, the PPT presentation shall also include detailed presentation of the Bidders experience in executing similar projects in other States.
Bidder should have minimum Annual turnover of Rs.250.00 crores in any 3 years of the last five preceding financial years i.e. 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24 , 2024-25 and 2025-26

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover
